definitions.t2m_1800_c: 2 m temperature at 18:00 local (22:00 UTC), C.
definitions.d2m_1800_c: 2 m dew point at 18:00 local, C.
definitions.dewpoint_depression_1800_c: t2m minus d2m at 18:00 local, C.
definitions.rh_1800_pct: Relative humidity at 18:00 local from t2m and d2m (Magnus, 17.62 and 243.12 C), %.
definitions.wind_1800_ms: 10 m wind speed sqrt(u10^2 + v10^2) at 18:00 local, m s-1.
definitions.ssrd_1800_wm2: Downward shortwave radiation over the hour ending at 18:00 local, W m-2.
definitions.strd_1800_wm2: Downward longwave radiation over the hour ending at 18:00 local, W m-2.
definitions.ssrd_afternoon_mean_wm2: Mean ssrd for hours ending 12:00 to 17:00 local (16:00 to 21:00 UTC), W m-2.
definitions.strd_afternoon_mean_wm2: Mean strd for hours ending 12:00 to 17:00 local, W m-2.
definitions.stl1_1800_c: Soil temperature level 1 (0 to 7 cm) at 18:00 local, C.
definitions.precip_24h_mm: Total precipitation over the 24 hours ending at 18:00 local, mm.
definitions.prev_night_tmin_c: Minimum t2m of the previous night (18:00 local of D-1 to 09:00 local of D), C.
definitions.cooling_rate_1500_1800_c_per_h: (t2m at 18:00 minus t2m at 15:00 local) / 3, C per hour.
definitions.doy_sin: sin(2 pi doy / 365.25), doy of D.
definitions.doy_cos: cos(2 pi doy / 365.25), doy of D.
definitions.latitude: Latitude of the ERA5-Land cell, degrees.
definitions.elevation_proxy_m: Elevation proxy from the cell mean surface pressure over training years, standard atmosphere: 44330.8 * (1 - (p / 1013.25) ^ 0.190263), m.
definitions.sky_emissivity_1800: strd_1800_wm2 / (5.670374419e-8 * t2m_1800_K^4), dimensionless. Higher means a more emissive (cloudier or moister) sky.
definitions.afternoon_clearness: ssrd_afternoon_mean_wm2 divided by the 95th percentile of that quantity for the same cell and day-of-year window (+-7 days) over training years, clipped to [0, 1].
definitions.cloud_cover_prev_day: AgERA5 24 h mean cloud cover (00:00 to 00:00 local) of day D-1, fraction 0 to 1. Joined by point_id and date.

label_definition: frost = 1 if the minimum hourly ERA5-Land t2m from 22:00 UTC of D to 13:00 UTC of D+1 (18:00 to 09:00 local, 16 values) is <= 0 C. tmin_c is that minimum. Labels come from the same reanalysis as the features.
